i18n.enTitle: 10 examples of AI agents! Explanation of everything from familiar tools to work-specific movements

i18n.enTitle: Explaining how to calculate ROI of AI agent! From calculation formulas and KPI design to trial calculation examples
i18n.enSummary: When asked about the effects of introducing an AI agent, many managers are unable to convert the time saved into monetary terms. ROI can be calculated by subtracting the total cost from the benefits obtained from implementation and dividing by the total cost. However, the cost of AI agents changes each time they are executed, so the same estimates as traditional SaaS will result in different numbers. If you proceed without measuring the numbers before implementation, you will not be able to demonstrate the effectiveness and your budget will be cut off. Once you understand the calculation formula and cost breakdown, you can create a trial calculation that can be used directly for approval.

i18n.zhSummary: 虽然AI代理已经投入生产，但尚未确定谁会看到什么以及如果发生错误操作会停止什么。在本文中，我们将以可直接在运营设计文件和审批文件中使用的形式解释运行AI代理时需要管理的七个项目以及启动的五个步骤。即使人工智能代理在 PoC 中运行良好，它也可能在现实生活中给出错误的答案或运行意想不到的工具。仅靠传统的系统监控无法确认决策的正确性，并且使用趋于扩散，而操作人员仍然感到不安。加特纳公司
i18n.enTitle: How to start operating AI agents! Explaining management items, systems, and improvement cycles that do not stop during production
i18n.enSummary: Although the AI ​​agent has been put into production, it has not yet been determined who will see what and what to stop if an erroneous operation occurs. In this article, we will explain the seven items that need to be managed when operating an AI agent and the five steps to get started, in a form that can be used directly in operation design documents and approval documents. Even if an AI agent works well in PoC, it may give incorrect answers or run unexpected tools in real life. Conventional system monitoring alone cannot confirm the correctness of decisions, and usage tends to spread while operators remain uneasy. Gartner

i18n.zhTitle: 如何利用人工智能代理客户支持！我们可以做什么以及实施示例
i18n.zhSummary: 尽管咨询量不断增加，但我们无法聘请接线员，即使安装了常见问题解答聊天机器人，我们最终也不得不处理人工咨询。在本文中，我们将重点介绍客户支持中可以委托给 AI 代理的任务，以及基于 Klarna、KDDI 和 Tokio Marine & Nichido 等公司官方公告的实施示例。可能有许多 CS 部门经理正在寻找新的解决方案，同时担心响应等待时间长和响应质量不稳定。
i18n.enTitle: How to utilize AI agent customer support! What we can do and examples of implementation
i18n.enSummary: Although the number of inquiries continues to increase, we are unable to hire operators, and even after installing an FAQ chatbot, we end up having to deal with manned inquiries. In this article, we will focus on the tasks that can be entrusted to AI agents in customer support, as well as implementation examples based on official announcements from companies such as Klarna, KDDI, and Tokio Marine & Nichido. There are probably many CS department managers who are looking for a new solution while worrying about long response wait times and inconsistent response quality.
